messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please select the video produced by the first hairstyle change, then use it as the starting point for the following edit: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands on a rooftop, first with her back to the camera, then raises one arm to touch her hair while placing the other hand on her hip, and finally turns to face forward with arms crossed.","camera":"A static, medium-long shot at roughly eye level, keeping the character centered against the city backdrop.","clothing":"A short, form-fitting dress with a dark green upper bodice and a black-and-yellow floral skirt, plus bright blue sneakers.","hair_color":"Blonde.","hairstyle":"Blonde hair pulled back into a low bun at the nape of the neck.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build and tanned skin, shown mostly from behind and in profile.","scene":"A futuristic city rooftop at dusk, with reflective tiled flooring, large buildings, construction cranes, and glowing pink neon signs in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background was replaced from a road under a concrete overpass with construction barriers to a futuristic city rooftop with reflective tiled flooring, buildings, cranes, and pink neon signs. The person remains in the same pose sequence and centered framing, and the lighting now matches the dusk rooftop environment.
arguments.requested_change: Change the scene to the futuristic rooftop setting shown in the reference image, placing the person there while retaining her identity, appearance, expression, action, and the existing camera framing and movement.
unexpected_changes: The character's arm pads appear more blue in the output than in the source, likely due to the new environment lighting.
